note: Creatives are typographic concept cards (SVG). Export to PNG at upload. Each carries a visible 'Concept. In development.' label. No app screens are shown. No mention of competitors or of mental health.

creatives.angle: new phone, where did my journal go
creatives.primary_text: A private journal in development that keeps entries on your phone and writes a backup file you choose. The concept: test that the backup opens before you need it. Early access, nothing is charged today.
creatives.headline: A backup you can actually open

creatives.primary_text: A journal concept with no AI and no account. Entries stay on your phone behind a lock. In development. Join the early-access list, nothing is charged today.
creatives.headline: A journal with no AI

creatives.angle: lock it, nothing leaves the phone
creatives.primary_text: Lock your journal and keep it on the device. A concept in development, with a backup that restores on a new phone. Early access, nothing is charged today.
creatives.headline: Your entries stay on your phone
